tasks.name: Create public GitHub repository vjumbo264/codex and seed BUILD_STATE.json
tasks.notes: Repo created via GitHub API (201 Created), public visibility, under vjumbo264. BUILD_STATE.json seeded with full task list, this seed commit pushed to origin/main as the initial commit.
tasks.tested: Repo GET returns 200 after creation; seed push verified on origin/main.

tasks.name: Design and commit Markdown note-tree schema + ARCHITECTURE.md
tasks.notes: Schema designed and documented in ARCHITECTURE.md: topics=directories under notebook/ (unlimited nesting via filesystem), each node has index.md (# Title + entry blocks of <!-- e:id --> / _UTC date_ / body / ---) and assets/ for images (relative ![alt](assets/file) refs). Entry ids = yyyymmdd-hhmmss-rand4 (sortable, unique, deterministic edit/delete targets). h8 = sha1(path)[:8] node handles for callback_data. Stateless multi-step flows via ForceReply #cx: tokens. No D1/KV - directory structure is single source of truth. PDF render is mechanical (pdf-lib). Gemini strictly limited to 4 reasoning cases; manual path has zero Gemini imports.
tasks.tested: ARCHITECTURE.md reviewed against all three hard requirements (mechanical PDF, clean Telegram Markdown, unlimited nesting).

tasks.name: Scaffold Cloudflare Worker project + create Worker + GitHub auto-deploy connection
tasks.notes: Worker codex-bot created and live at https://codex-bot.vjumbo264.workers.dev (subdomain vjumbo264 created via API). Scaffold: index.js webhook w/ secret-token verification + ctx.waitUntil ack pattern; scaffold router.js. wrangler.toml Data rule bundles DejaVuSans(+Bold) fonts. Deploy pipeline: push to main touching worker/** triggers .github/workflows/deploy.yml -> wrangler-action deploys. Verified: initial wrangler deploy ok, scaffold push triggered Actions run 33795904069 = success, GET / returns 200. Worker secrets set via CF API: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, GITHUB_REPO_TOKEN, WEBHOOK_SECRET. GH Actions secrets set: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. PAT self-PATCH added workflows permission so workflow files push fine. node_modules excluded via .gitignore after first push rejection.
tasks.tested: wrangler deploy OK; GET https://codex-bot.vjumbo264.workers.dev/ -> 200; Actions run 33795904069 completed success (auto-deploy on push works).

tasks.name: Implement GitHub-as-database access from the Worker
tasks.notes: github.js = Contents API getFile/putFile/putBinaryFile/deleteFile + recursive git/trees listing with 20s isolate cache (invalidated on every write) + rawUrl helper (public repo -> no creds for raw bytes). tree.js = node model over the tree (listNodePaths, getNodes w/ children, resolveH8 via sha1(path)[:8] with 12-char widening on collision, findByName, resolvePath, uniqueChildSlug, filesUnderNode). notes.js = parseIndex/serializeIndex round-trip on the ARCHITECTURE.md grammar, createNode/ensureNode/appendEntry/updateEntry/deleteEntry/deleteNodeTree/storeImage/moveEntry (image refs rewritten + assets copied). Credential: fine-grained PAT in Worker secret GITHUB_REPO_TOKEN, used only for writes. VALIDATED: node syntax-check x10; node-side round-trip test (serialize->parse->append->reparse) all true; LIVE round-trip against real repo passed end-to-end.
tasks.tested: node --check all modules OK; pure-logic round-trip test OK; live create/append/read/list/delete round-trip against vjumbo264/codex OK (test node zz-dbcheck created and fully removed).

tasks.name: Manual command path end-to-end (zero Gemini): /new /add /delete /topics browsing, in-chat reading (paginated, images inline), PDF export (node+descendants or full notebook)
tasks.notes: Fully deterministic. Delete requires inline Yes/Cancel confirmation. PDF render is mechanical Markdown->PDF with inline images, no AI.

tasks.name: Voice note ingestion and image ingestion
tasks.notes: Receive Telegram voice/image files via getFile, store images in repo under node assets, associate images with correct entry/node. Voice audio is transcribed (task-07) then discarded — only cleaned text is stored.

tasks.name: Gemini integration for reasoning-required paths only
tasks.notes: Voice transcription+cleanup, auto-filing unspecified notes against existing tree, editing notes via natural request, ambiguous-target resolution. Intent-dispatch architecture: Gemini identifies function+target, deterministic function executes. Gemini key added by operator post-build per README (Worker secret GEMINI_API_KEY); build must not block on it — all manual paths must work without it.

tasks.name: Gemini-triggered versions of every manual capability (delete/export/read/browse-equivalent)
tasks.notes: Plain-language requests dispatch to the same underlying deterministic functions with minimal-reasoning intent recognition. Gemini never re-reads/re-rewrites/re-processes existing content for these.

tasks.name: Quick-action buttons after auto-filed notes + live status message editing
tasks.notes: After auto-file: confirm where note landed with view/move/make-new-topic buttons. Multi-step ops edit one status message (Transcribing… -> Filing… -> Done).

tasks.name: Set Telegram webhook to deployed Worker URL and verify bot responds live
tasks.notes: Use setWebhook with TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (env var, never in files) pointing at the Worker route; verify with getWebhookInfo and a real bot API round-trip.

tasks.name: Write README: phone/browser-friendly Gemini key setup + usage guide
tasks.notes: No CLI/desktop assumptions — operator uses Android + Termux + browser dashboards. Steps to add GEMINI_API_KEY Worker secret via Cloudflare dashboard. Usage: capture, browse, read, export, edit, delete — manual and via Gemini.

tasks.name: End-to-end live verification of every required capability; then set build_complete: true
tasks.notes: Exercise all required capabilities against the live bot. Spot-check that manual/explicit operations make zero Gemini calls. Only then mark build_complete: true, commit, push.
